patches.decision_note: The generic statement that four production-ready pareo files were delivered does not explicitly identify the terracotta artwork and is already represented by the print-ready output Requirement.
The source does not claim that the selected Zebra Obsidian artwork was delivered; it names only an optional Zebra Dune repeat tile and generically references four pareo files.
The Zebra Dune tile is explicitly described as a bonus not required for the production run, so its inclusion does not conflict with the client's Zebra Obsidian selection.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Claire Rowan! The rescaled files at 133 x 173cm are now in the Drive folder called "Resize". Just be aware that the Technical Sheet continues to display the old measurements — those can be changed easily using any PDF editor.
I also have one small request: local tax regulations require me to provide an official export invoice for the work we’ve done together. Could you send me your full name, address (street, city, state, zip code) and email?
Once you’re ready to close the contract on Upwork, you’ll be asked to leave a review at that point — I’d be very grateful if you did!
Best wishes,
Mara

execution.observed_behavior: After the artwork files were rescaled to 133 x 173 cm, the delivered Technical Sheet still displayed the obsolete measurements.

patches.decision_note: This is the first concrete post-delivery evidence that the final package contained supplier-facing documentation inconsistent with the resized artwork.
